# Chess Tournament Calendar

> A calendar of classical and rapid chess tournaments from around the world. Tournament data comes from chess-results.com and ratings.fide.com and is refreshed automatically several times a day.

This site lists upcoming, open-entry chess tournaments (both classical and rapid time controls), including dates, location, duration, number of players registered, and time control information. It does not organize tournaments or take entries: every listing links to the tournament's own registration page or website.

## Pages

- [Tournament Calendar](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/): Full list of upcoming chess tournaments worldwide, filterable by country, month, duration, and time control (Classical / Rapid). Also available in [Spanish](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/es/), [Portuguese](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/pt/), [German](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/de/), [Czech](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/cs/), and [Finnish](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/fi/).
- [Continent pages](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/continent/europe/): Tournaments filtered to one continent (e.g. Europe, Asia), each linking to its top countries. Available for every continent with active tournaments.
- [Country pages](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/country/finland/): Tournaments filtered to one country. Available for every country with active tournaments.
- Tournament pages (`/tournament/<slug>/`): One page per tournament with dates, location, time control, registered players, a map, and calendar export. Pages for finished tournaments stay available for a couple of months but are not indexed.
- [About](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/about/): Where the data comes from and who runs the site. Also in the other languages.
- [Contact & Feedback](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/contact/): Send feedback, report issues, or enquire about tournament partnerships.
- [Privacy Policy](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/privacy/): What the site collects and how to opt out (English only).

## Data

- [Upcoming tournaments (JSON)](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/data/tournaments.json): Machine-readable list of upcoming tournaments from both sources. Refreshed together with the site.
- [All tournaments seen (JSON)](https://chesstournamentcalendar.com/data/archive-all.json): Every tournament the site has listed, including finished ones, from both sources. The `source` field is `chess-results` or `fide-ratings`, and `status` is `upcoming` or `concluded`.

## Sources

- chess-results.com: tournaments worldwide.
- ratings.fide.com: FIDE-registered tournaments in the United States, Australia, Norway and Denmark, where chess-results.com has little coverage.

## Details

Each tournament entry includes:
- Name and registration/info link
- Start and end dates
- City and country
- Duration in days
- Time control (Classical or Rapid)
- Number of players currently registered (when available)

The pages embed structured data (schema.org Event, JSON-LD) for the tournaments they list.
